note: One object per lender card on /bitcoin-lenders. Every figure is what the lender published on each card's asOf, read from its sources. 'not published' is a value, never an estimate. The page computes trigger prices from ltv.open/call/liq and the live bitcoin price (trigger = price × open ÷ threshold; drawdown = 1 − open ÷ threshold), the same arithmetic as Borrowing Against Your Stack's loan-health calculator. ltv.reference marks a lender with no published maximum opening LTV, quoted at a 50% loan. trig.mode 'auto' builds the trigger sentence from the numbers; 'text' uses trig.static at build and trig.live (with {price} {call} {callPct} {liq} {liqPct} placeholders) once the live price is known. filters.* are booleans the filter chips read; states.type is all | include | exclude | unknown | none with states.list where published; states.rest 'unknown' on an exclude list means the lender names exclusions but publishes no list for the rest. Refresh: MONTHLY_REFRESH_CHECKLIST (rates monthly, full card quarterly); DATA_AUDIT LEN-1 to LEN-19.

groups.title: Custodial lenders
groups.sub: You hand the lender your bitcoin for the life of the loan. The questions are who holds it, whether it can be lent on, and what a margin call actually does. Coinbase is under DeFi: its loan is a Morpho position in cbBTC behind a Coinbase screen.

groups.title: Exchange credit lines and margin
groups.sub: Borrowing inside an exchange account. The collateral is an exchange balance, often of many assets, measured by the exchange's own rules. Kraken has two products: a loan you can withdraw (Flexline) and buying power you can't (Borrow US).

groups.title: Multisig: you hold a key
groups.sub: The collateral sits in a multisig address you can watch on-chain, and the lender can't move it alone. The price of that is a different liquidation: the coins go to the lender, often all of them, rather than being partly sold.

groups.title: DeFi: wrapped bitcoin, not bitcoin
groups.sub: The collateral is an IOU for bitcoin (cbBTC, WBTC) whose issuer holds the real coins, locked in a lending contract anyone can liquidate. No lender, no KYC, no notice. Coinbase's loan product is the first card: a Morpho position in cbBTC.

groups.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages
groups.sub: The loan buys a house, and the house is collateral alongside the bitcoin; the money can't be used for anything else, the term is 30 years, and the lender is a mortgage company. Described here for completeness; the mechanics and the tax angle are on Borrowing Against Your Stack → mortgages.

lenders.name: Strike

rate.note: APR, fixed; tiered by loan size (11.25% under ~$250K)

trig.extra: The 6-month Volatility-proof loan opens at 40%, has no price trigger, and costs about 3 points more; a missed payment can still liquidate it.

lenders.coins: Held by Strike or its capital providers, segregated; “no further rehypothecation”
lenders.terms: 12 mo (6 mo volatility-proof) or a revolving line; no origination, prepayment or liquidation fees
lenders.where: “Select US states”; the line of credit in 38 states + DC; volatility-proof not in CA, NY, TX
lenders.distinguishing: The only US lender with a loan that can’t be liquidated by price; a full bitcoin app around it
lenders.catch: Rates are tiered: small loans pay the top rate. Its collateral goes to “capital providers”, whose names Strike doesn’t publish
lenders.track: Lending since 2025; no custody incident on record

states.note: Strike’s March 2026 post: term loans in 50 states + DC + PR; the volatility-proof loan not in CA, NY, TX

lenders.name: Ledn

rate.note: APR; tiered by loan size (11.49% under $250K)

lenders.coins: “Custodied loan”: verifiable custody; may be re-posted to a funding partner or ring-fenced vehicle, but no one may lend it out
lenders.terms: 12 mo; interest due at close (paid in full at maturity from 2027); no prepayment penalty; 2% admin fee waived for US and Canada
lenders.where: Not in about 10 US states, including CA and CT (lender list to confirm at build)
lenders.distinguishing: The lowest minimum and the longest bitcoin-only lending record (since 2018); proof-of-reserves reporting
lenders.catch: Retrieving excess collateral needs LTV under 30%, a 60-day-old loan, and is capped at $100K per 60 days

states.note: Ledn publishes no US state list; third-party charts show about 10 excluded states including CA and CT

lenders.name: Figure

rate.note: APR incl. 1% origination; 8.91% rate at 50% LTV, 11.5% up to 75%

trig.live: At {price}, a 50% loan gets its margin-call warning at {call} ({callPct}). A 75% loan is warned after a 6% fall (its 80% line). Optional Liquidation Protection, 2% up front, removes price liquidations on 50% BTC loans in 10 states.
trig.static: A 50% loan gets its margin-call warning after a 33% fall; a 75% loan after a 6% fall (its 80% line). Optional Liquidation Protection, 2% up front, removes price liquidations on 50% BTC loans in 10 states.

lenders.coins: Segregated MPC wallet with an address you can watch; Figure states no rehypothecation
lenders.terms: 12 mo interest-only; interest can be deferred to maturity; 1% origination, 2% liquidation fee; rates “change frequently”
lenders.where: Not in DC, ID, IL, KY, MD, MS, SD, TX, VT, VA; international via a separate entity
lenders.distinguishing: A large, state-licensed consumer lender ($11B originated) with a soft credit pull and same-day approval
lenders.catch: Collateral is locked until full repayment, whatever bitcoin does; the liquidation LTV isn’t published; altcoins share the platform
lenders.track: Consumer lender since 2018; crypto loans newer; “never lost coin assets or paused withdrawals”

lenders.name: Arch
lenders.model: Custodial · ChainFi, Inc. · NMLS 2637200 · Anchorage custody

rate.note: APR incl. origination (0.25–1.49%); by loan size, 10.49% under $250K; deferred-interest ~0.5 pt more (table of 19 May 2026)

lenders.coins: Segregated cold storage at Anchorage Digital Bank, described as bankruptcy-remote; “never rehypothecates”; no watchable address published
lenders.terms: 1–12 mo, rollover at maturity; monthly interest or deferred; no prepayment fee; late fees “may apply”
lenders.where: Arch’s own pages carry three different state lists; the eligibility article (June 2026) lists 44 states + DC + PR, the footer excludes CA, DE, HI, MS, MT, NV, ND, RI, VT
lenders.distinguishing: The highest opening LTV among the custodial lenders (60%) with a stated 24-hour cure and partial liquidation only back to 60%
lenders.catch: A 60→70→80 band means a 14% fall triggers the call; Arch’s pages disagree on states, rates and origination, so only the app quote is reliable
lenders.track: Founded 2022 (press); $75M raised 2024; no incidents or actions published

states.note: Arch’s June 2026 eligibility article; its site footer gives a different list

lenders.name: SALT
lenders.model: Custodial · SALT Lending LLC · NMLS 1711910 · 26 state licences

rate.note: APR, fixed for the term, by LTV tier not size: 30% LTV 7.49% (1 yr) to 8.49% (5 yr); 50% 8.75–9.75%; 70% 10.50% (1 yr only)

ltv.callNote: notices at 75 and 88%; no cure window stated
ltv.liqNote: “margin event”: sold (5%) or converted to USDC (3%)

trig.extra: At 50% LTV the margin event comes after a 45% fall. Stabilization converts collateral to USDC at the trigger instead of selling it; 2% to convert back once LTV is under 83.33%.

lenders.coins: “No rehypothecation”; custodian not named on product pages (a 2024 post names BitGo Trust); collateral “may be transferred between custodial solutions”, so no fixed address to watch
lenders.terms: 1, 3 or 5 yr; interest-only, amortising, or accrued to maturity; 0% origination and prepayment; 1.5% on crypto payments off autopay
lenders.where: Every US state except NY, ND, SD, plus DC and PR; also Canada, UK, Switzerland, UAE, Australia and others
lenders.distinguishing: Fixed 3- and 5-year terms, and Stabilization in place of a sale
lenders.catch: The 90.91% trigger leaves little room and costs 3–5% plus 2% to re-enter; SALT paused withdrawals on 15 Nov 2022 and its California licence was suspended until Jan 2025
lenders.track: Founded 2016; SEC token settlement 2020 ($250K); withdrawals paused Nov 2022, $64M recapitalisation Feb 2023; CA licence reinstated 2025 under a DFPI consent order; “zero customer funds lost”
lenders.sourcesLabel: saltlending.com rates-and-fees, faq.saltlending.com, its own notices

lenders.name: APX
lenders.model: Custodial · APX Inc., Toronto · FinCEN MSB · BitGo Trust custody

rate.note: fixed for the term, by loan size (11.49% under $100K); $0 origination, so APR = rate; line of credit 10.49–11.99%

ltv.callNote: notices every 6 h; “no margin call”, no cure period
ltv.liqNote: partial, back to 85%; 0% fee since 25 Aug 2026

lenders.coins: Segregated cold wallet per client at BitGo Trust, visible on-chain; “never pooled or rehypothecated”. Its own risk disclosure: in an APX insolvency a borrower’s claim “could be treated as unsecured”
lenders.terms: 3–60 mo, extendable; interest-only, amortised or deferred; closing early costs a minimum of three months’ interest
lenders.minimum: $25,000 for US borrowers (C$10,000 in Canada); “no fixed maximum”
lenders.where: “Residents of the U.S. and Canada”; US borrowers are paid in USDC only; no US state list or state licence published; the Canadian regulatory relief (CSA, April 2025) covers Canadians only
lenders.distinguishing: The highest liquidation line of the custodial lenders (90%), partial to 85%, no fee
lenders.catch: For a US borrower the regulatory cover is an MSB registration, the payout is USDC, the minimum is $25K, and the insolvency language above
lenders.track: Founded 2022 by the ex-Coinberry team; CSA exemptive relief April 2025; no incidents published; not operating in 2022

states.note: APX publishes no US state list

lenders.name: Lava
lenders.model: Revolving line · Lava Global Inc. · no licence shown

rate.note: fixed for a year, by balance (8.50% under $250K), plus a 2% “capital charge” on the year’s peak balance: a real first-year cost of 8.5–10.5%

ltv.liqNote: a price shown in the app when you draw; full, nothing returned

trig.static: The liquidation price is shown in the app at each draw, not on the site. When it is hit “your line of credit will be liquidated in full” and “Lava does not return any collateral”: the excess is kept as the liquidation fee.

lenders.coins: “Never lent out, traded, or otherwise rehypothecated”; custody wording varies: the FAQ says a “distributed key protocol … with institutional-grade custodians”, the terms call the wallet “purely self-custodial”; no watchable address published
lenders.terms: No term, no maturity, no monthly payments; draw again up to the limit; no origination or early-repayment fee
lenders.where: “Available globally”; no US state list or licence published
lenders.distinguishing: The lowest minimum and the only revolving line with no payments and no end date
lenders.catch: A liquidation takes the whole position and returns nothing, at a trigger the site doesn’t publish; the capital charge is a second interest rate
lenders.track: Line of credit since Nov 2025; $200M raised Nov 2025; did not exist in 2022; no incidents published

lenders.name: Kraken Flexline

rate.note: APR, fixed for the term; BTC short-term borrows under 10%

trig.static: No LTV trigger to convert into a price: Kraken measures a margin level across your whole Pro account with per-asset haircuts, and shows the liquidation threshold in the app before you confirm. Kraken’s own illustration starts at 40% LTV.

lenders.coins: Stay in your Kraken Pro main wallet, inside its proof-of-reserves; exchange custody, not segregated for you
lenders.terms: 2 days to 2 years; 0.5% origination; interest every 4 hours; early-termination fee; proceeds in USDC, USDG, BTC and others
lenders.where: US: 40 states + DC, and only for Eligible Contract Participants (roughly $10M invested, or a $10M-asset entity); not in CA, NY, MA, CT and 7 others
lenders.distinguishing: Fixed rates for terms as short as two days, and the only one here where a short bitcoin borrow can price under 10%
lenders.catch: For US individuals it is effectively a $10M-net-worth product; the collateral is an exchange balance, and 47 other assets share the risk engine
lenders.track: Exchange since 2011, “never breached”; Flexline since Feb 2026 (US June 2026)

states.note: and only for Eligible Contract Participants

lenders.name: Kraken Borrow
lenders.model: US product · Kraken Derivatives US (CFTC FCM)

rate.headline: not published
rate.note: variable; a one-time borrow fee plus daily interest, both shown before you confirm; collected every 4 hours

trig.static: No price to quote: Kraken publishes a health status, not an LTV. Its own example: $100 of cash buys $400 of crypto; the $300 borrowed is 75% of what you then hold, so the position starts nearer a liquidation than any loan on this page. Sales can leave a balance still owed.

lenders.coins: The crypto bought with borrowed dollars is held at Kraken Derivatives US and can’t be withdrawn or sent until repaid; you can sell it
lenders.terms: No repayment deadline, no minimum payment; repay in USD (free) or by selling any asset (conversion fee); a trading fee on the cash part
lenders.where: 48 states, not NY or ME; not for Eligible Contract Participants (over $10M invested), the reverse of Flexline
lenders.distinguishing: The Kraken product an ordinary US customer can actually use, launched 24 Sep 2026; no term, no minimum payment
lenders.catch: It isn’t a loan against your stack: the borrowed dollars can only buy more crypto on Kraken. It is leverage, and losses “may exceed the initial investment”
lenders.track: Spot margin via NinjaTrader Clearing; product 6 days old
lenders.sourcesLabel: kraken.com/features/borrow, blog 24 Sep 2026, support “Kraken Borrow US”

lenders.name: Nexo
lenders.model: Exchange credit line · Nexo US, LLC; lender of record a “Bank Partner” or affiliate; Bakkt wallet

rate.note: base, variable; 12.9% to 7.9% by “Wealth Tier”, which means the share of your portfolio held in NEXO token; 0.9–2.9% only with NEXO and LTV under 20%; repay within 45 days and the base rate applies

ltv.callNote: “may receive margin call emails”; no cure window
ltv.liqNote: automatic sale of part or all; 2–3.5% fee + spread

lenders.coins: Pooled exchange “credit wallet” in multi-sig cold storage with Bakkt and Fireblocks; whether it may be lent or re-pledged: not published for the US; no watchable address
lenders.terms: No fixed term; 1-year maturity auto-extended; no scheduled payments; repay in crypto (0.26% + spread) or stablecoins/USD (0%)
lenders.where: Accounts not in New York or American Samoa; the credit line “may not be available in your jurisdiction”; no state list
lenders.distinguishing: 100+ collateral assets in one credit line, a $50 minimum, and sub-1% rates for large NEXO-token holders at low LTV
lenders.catch: Without NEXO token the rate is 15.9%; auto-sale at 83.33% with no cure window; Nexo US is not the lender of record
lenders.track: Since 2018; left the US Dec 2022; Jan 2023 $45M settlement with the SEC and states over its Earn product, without admitting or denying; returned Feb 2026 via Bakkt

states.note: accounts not in New York; no state list for the credit line

lenders.sourcesLabel: nexo.com/us, support.nexo.com US articles, US terms and fee schedule, SEC release 2023-11

lenders.name: Unchained
lenders.model: 2-of-3 multisig · Unchained Capital, Inc. · NMLS 1900773 · Key Agent: Fortis Bank

rate.note: APR: 12.00% interest + 2.00% origination, one rate at every size (as of Nov 2025)

ltv.liqNote: 120% CTP; sold to repay and close the loan; 2% fee

trig.extra: A sale at the 120% line closes the whole loan, not just the shortfall; the remainder is returned.

lenders.coins: In a 2-of-3 address: you, Unchained, and the Key Agent; you verify the address on your own hardware wallet; “does NOT rehypothecate”; held in a sub-trust Unchained calls bankruptcy-remote
lenders.terms: 360 days; 12 interest-only payments every 30 days, principal at maturity; no prepayment penalty; commercial purpose only
lenders.minimum: $150,000 for entities; $500,000 for individuals and trusts “in most cases”; $1M in Vermont
lenders.where: US only; not LA, MT, NV, NM, NY, ND, SD, PR; MI, MS, OH entities only
lenders.distinguishing: You hold a key and watch the address; lending since June 2017 with “zero lost bitcoin”
lenders.catch: The most expensive rate and largest minimum on the page; commercial purpose only; a 24-hour cure; the foreclosure sale closes the loan
lenders.track: First loan June 2017; $1B+ originated; Nov 2022: no FTX exposure but funding “materially constrained”, ~15% layoffs

states.note: MI, MS, OH entities only; VT $1M minimum

lenders.name: Firefish
lenders.model: P2P escrow · Firefish Europe s.r.o. · MiCA CASP · investors fund the loans

rate.headline: from 5%
rate.note: set by the investor who takes your offer; 12-month EUR loans “below 9.5% APR” (Q1 2026); full-term interest owed even if repaid early; plus 1.5% p.a. origination in BTC

ltv.liqNote: the entire collateral goes to the liquidator

trig.extra: A touch of 95% “even for only a couple of seconds” counts, and partial repayment doesn’t lower the LTV.

lenders.coins: 3-of-3 escrow: two Firefish oracle keys and your own ephemeral key, which pre-signs the closing transactions and is then discarded; one address per loan to watch; a recovery transaction returns the coins a month after maturity if Firefish disappears
lenders.terms: 3–24 mo; one bullet repayment at maturity; 1.5% p.a. origination; 5% fee on default; EUR, CHF, CZK, PLN, USDC, USDT
lenders.where: Fiat loans in 34 European countries; elsewhere USDC/USDT only. The ineligible list doesn’t name the United States, but the terms make you warrant you’re somewhere Firefish needs no licence: no explicit US statement
lenders.distinguishing: No party, Firefish included, can redirect the coins once escrowed; investors need no bitcoin knowledge
lenders.catch: At 95% the whole stack goes, no partial sale; both oracle keys are Firefish’s; full-term interest regardless; Czech law
lenders.track: Since May 2022; $533M+ processed; zero liquidations through 2025, then ~$2.5M liquidated on 6 Feb 2026 at the disclosed 95%
lenders.sourcesLabel: firefish.io, docs.firefish.io FAQ and legal, fee schedule PDF

lenders.name: Debifi
lenders.model: 3-of-4 multisig · Debifi Development Ltd, Cyprus · lenders are named institutions

rate.note: APR, fixed per offer; the offer book today: 8.5–10.25% at 50% LTV for $100K+ (Goldstream), 9.5–10% at 60–70% for $20K–$100K; plus 1.0–1.5% origination in BTC

ltv.liqNote: or stricter per lender; coins go to the lender; 5% fee

trig.extra: At 50% LTV the 90% line is a 44% fall away. An optional 12–48 h “delayed liquidation” cancels if the initial LTV is restored.

lenders.coins: 3-of-4: you, the lender, Debifi, and an independent key holder (AnchorWatch) who signs only if a party won’t; one address per loan to watch; “never re-lent, staked, or traded”
lenders.terms: 1–24 mo; interest monthly to annually per offer, principal at maturity; extension 0.6–1.5%; no early-repayment fee
lenders.where: “Available globally”; the terms exclude sanctioned countries and Puerto Rico; each lender applies its own KYC
lenders.distinguishing: A fourth, independent key and a public offer book of named institutional lenders
lenders.catch: Your lender is whichever fund took the offer, with its own KYC and liquidation line; the FAQ and the terms disagree on the 5% fee base and on manual vs automatic liquidation; your key lives in the Debifi app
lenders.track: Launched 2022 (press); monthly stats published; no incidents published

lenders.name: Hodl Hodl Lend
lenders.model: P2P 2-of-3 · Hodlex Ltd, Marshall Islands · no KYC

rate.note: APR on today’s borrow offers; set by the lender, a fixed sum for the term; plus 1.5% origination in BTC

ltv.liqNote: coins transferred to the lender, surplus returned; 5% fee

lenders.coins: 2-of-3: you, the lender, the platform; keys locked by a per-contract payment password that “cannot be restored”; address watchable on-chain
lenders.terms: 1–12 mo; repayment at maturity, partials any time; crypto-to-crypto only (USDT, USDC, L-BTC, WBTC, XAUT)
lenders.where: Terms effective 4 Jun 2026 bar US citizens, residents and persons located in the US, all states and territories; also Russia, Belarus and sanctioned countries
lenders.distinguishing: No identity check at all, a $50 minimum, borrower-written terms
lenders.catch: US persons are excluded (its 2020 post had opened to them); $25K cap; the lender is an anonymous user; a lost payment password loses the collateral
lenders.track: Hodlex since 2016; Lend since Oct 2020; publishes nothing about 2022; no incidents published
lenders.sourcesLabel: lend.hodlhodl.com FAQ, offers, terms of service

lenders.name: Coinbase
lenders.model: Morpho position in cbBTC · Coinbase, Inc. is the interface, not the lender

rate.headline: from 5.1%
rate.note: variable, set by the Morpho market, plus a Coinbase platform fee (amount not published); fixed-rate option; a 2% processing fee on the first $250K of every draw (1% above), added to principal

trig.extra: Fixed-rate loans are liquidated at maturity if unpaid, at any LTV. “Coinbase cannot prevent your collateral from being liquidated on Morpho.”

lenders.coins: Your BTC leaves your Coinbase account, becomes cbBTC (Coinbase’s wrapper; the real coins are held by Coinbase) and is locked in a Morpho contract on Base; Coinbase says it has no access to it
lenders.terms: Variable: no term, no due dates. Fixed: repaid in full at maturity, early repayment doesn’t reduce interest. Processing fee charged again on every top-up draw
lenders.minimum: Not published; up to 5,000,000 USDC against BTC
lenders.where: US excluding New York; limited UK
lenders.distinguishing: The biggest brand on the page and the thinnest cushion: an on-chain position with an 86% line
lenders.catch: Interest accrues into the LTV, there is no margin call, and the collateral is a wrapper on a protocol Coinbase doesn’t control; the 2% fee recurs
lenders.track: Launched Jan 2025 (BTC only, $100K cap), since widened; the earlier “Coinbase Borrow” USD line stopped new loans May 2023; no lending incidents published

lenders.name: Morpho direct
lenders.model: cbBTC/USDC 86% market on Base · a protocol; the app is hosted by a French nonprofit

rate.note: variable (6-hour average, Base market, 30 Sep 2026); the Ethereum market 5.4%; no origination; gas only. The same pool Coinbase’s loans draw on, without Coinbase’s fee

ltv.liqNote: anyone may liquidate any amount; 4.38% penalty

trig.extra: A 70% loan is liquidated after a 19% fall. The oracle price, not the exchange price, decides.

lenders.coins: cbBTC in the Morpho contract; the real bitcoin is held by Coinbase; the position is visible on-chain; Coinbase’s own story says the collateral is not rehypothecated
lenders.terms: Open-ended; interest accrues into the position; no fees beyond gas (a fee switch of up to 25% of interest exists)
lenders.minimum: None; bounded by the pool’s liquidity ($166M at read)
lenders.where: No KYC; sanctioned territories only; the terms leave it to you to know whether you may use it
lenders.distinguishing: The lowest rate and penalty on the page
lenders.catch: No notice, a thin line, a wrapper that depends on Coinbase, and a protocol with no one to call
lenders.track: Markets since Sep 2024; realized bad debt 0; a 2025 front-end bug intercepted by a white hat (press); core contracts immutable
lenders.sourcesLabel: app.morpho.org market pages, docs, terms (11 Sep 2026)

lenders.name: Aave v3
lenders.model: Ethereum “Core” market · WBTC or cbBTC · a protocol; the app by Aave Labs

rate.note: variable, set by utilisation: USDT 4.46%, USDC 15.15% at 99.8% utilisation on 30 Sep 2026, with $4M left to borrow; no origination; gas only

trig.extra: A 50% loan is liquidated after a 36% fall. Up to half the debt is liquidated above health factor 0.95, all of it below.

lenders.coins: WBTC (custodied by the BitGo / BiT Global venture) or cbBTC (Coinbase) in the pool contract, where it is itself lent out to other borrowers; fully visible on-chain
lenders.terms: No term; interest accrues into the debt; no fees beyond gas and the penalty
lenders.minimum: None; bounded by borrow caps and liquidity
lenders.where: No KYC; sanctioned territories only; the US is not named
lenders.distinguishing: The only place here where the collateral is lent to other borrowers by design
lenders.catch: A 73% loan is 6% from liquidation; the stablecoin can run dry or spike (USDC 15% today); a 5–7.5% penalty with no notice; the wrapper’s custodian is a counterparty you didn’t choose
lenders.track: Since 2020; Nov 2022 ~$1.7M CRV bad debt covered; Apr 2026 rsETH incident, $191M borrowed against unbacked collateral, reserves frozen within 90 minutes
lenders.sourcesLabel: app.aave.com reserve pages, aave.com FAQ and terms, governance forum

lenders.name: Milo
lenders.model: 30-yr crypto mortgage · Milo Credit, LLC · NMLS 1811449

rate.note: fixed for 30 years, interest-only; the calculator today 7.950% on a $500K purchase; fees “about 2% to 4%” of the loan

ltv.openNote: of the price, with crypto pledged 1:1 to the loan
ltv.callNote: a fall in the collateral of “about 69%” (FAQ) or 65% (blog); no countdown
ltv.liqNote: “disclosed in your loan documents”; only the shortfall sold

trig.live: At {price}, the margin call Milo describes comes at roughly {px0.31}–{px0.35}, a 65–69% fall in bitcoin, because the house is collateral too. The liquidation line is in the loan documents, not on the site. Excess collateral can be withdrawn above ~125% of the loan.
trig.static: The margin call Milo describes comes after a 65–69% fall in bitcoin, because the house is collateral too. The liquidation line is in the loan documents, not on the site. Excess collateral can be withdrawn above ~125% of the loan.

lenders.coins: BitGo or Coinbase Custody, a sub-account in your name; no rehypothecation, staking or stablecoin conversion; locked “for the entire duration of the loan”
lenders.terms: 30-yr fixed, interest-only; principal at sale, refinance or prepayment; some loans carry a prepayment penalty up to three years; credit score ≥ 660; USD payments only
lenders.where: 37 states + DC per Milo’s state checker; not AK, AR, ID, KS, KY, MI, MN, NE, NV, NH, OR, SD, VT, PR
lenders.distinguishing: 100% financing with no cash down against a 1:1 pledge, fixed for 30 years
lenders.catch: The coins are locked until the house is sold or refinanced; the liquidation threshold is in the loan documents; Milo’s own pages disagree on the trigger and the rate range
lenders.track: Founded 2018; “$100M+ crypto mortgages”; “no margin calls to date” through the 2022 drawdown; no actions published
lenders.sourcesLabel: milo.io product pages, FAQ, calculator, state checker, blog (May 2026)

lenders.name: Better + Coinbase
lenders.model: Fannie Mae-conforming mortgage · Better Mortgage Corp · NMLS 330511 · Coinbase custodies

rate.headline: not published
rate.note: whatever conforming rate Better quotes, on both loans; 15- or 30-yr fixed; Coinbase One members get a 1% lender credit up to $10K

ltv.openNote: bitcoin counts at 40% of value (250% collateral)

trig.static: No price trigger at all: the pledged bitcoin is sold only if you are 60 days behind on payments; foreclosure on the house from day 180. The price can fall to zero without a call.

lenders.coins: Held by Better in its own Coinbase Prime account until the whole mortgage is repaid or refinanced, not just the down-payment loan. Whether Better may reuse the coins is not on its pages; press reports it may, keeping equivalent bitcoin on hand
lenders.terms: Two loans at closing: a conforming first mortgage plus a down-payment loan secured by the crypto and a second lien, same rate and term, one payment; FICO ≥ 680 and full Fannie Mae underwriting
lenders.distinguishing: The only product on the page with no price-driven liquidation, on a standard GSE mortgage
lenders.catch: You still qualify on income and credit like any conforming borrower; only 40% of the bitcoin counts; the coins stay pledged for the life of the mortgage, and the rehypothecation answer is press-only
lenders.track: Announced Mar 2026; first loan Jun 2026; general availability 26 Aug 2026; no incidents on this product
